facts.fact: The ITU repository lists Namibia's National ICT Policy / Broadband Policy, owned by the Ministry of ICT, with a time frame of 2018 to 2022 (phase); the document gives no event date, so its published year 2025 is used.

The ITU repository lists the National ICT Policy / Broadband Policy among Namibia's strategies with an official policy source and implementation evidence of training programmes; no adoption date is given, so its published year 2025 is used.
